banner.offline: You are offline. New entries are saved on this device and sent automatically when you are online.
banner.authRequired: Sign in again to send the entries waiting on this device.

toast.saved: Saved on this device. It will be sent when you are online.
toast.saveFailed: Could not save on this device. Keep this screen open and try again.

outbox.title: Waiting to send
outbox.subtitle: Entries saved on this device that have not reached the server yet. They are sent automatically when you are online.
outbox.empty: Nothing is waiting. Everything has been sent.

reason.server: The server had a problem. It will be tried again automatically.
reason.network: No connection. It will be sent when you are online.
reason.generic: The server did not accept this entry.

actions.discardConfirmText: The entry, its photos and signatures will be deleted from this device and will NOT be sent. This cannot be undone.

storage.warning: Until sent, these entries exist only in this browser. iPhone and iPad may delete data of apps that are not opened for about 7 days, so open Liftelo and send them as soon as you have signal.
storage.persisted: This device has agreed to keep the data.
storage.exportHint: As a last resort, export a backup file and keep it.

outbox.otherAccount: {{n}} more entries on this device belong to another account. Sign in with that account to send them.
outbox.exportFailed: Could not create the export file.

install.title: Install Liftelo on your phone
install.android: Add Liftelo to your home screen to open it like an app, also with a weak signal.
install.ios: On iPhone/iPad: tap the Share button in Safari, then "Add to Home Screen".
install.other: Open the browser menu and choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
install.installed: Liftelo is installed on this device.

update.available: A new version of Liftelo is available.
update.hint: Finish what you are typing first: the page reloads.
